messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "dulaglutide 1.5 mg once weekly"
set: ["dulaglutide 1.5 mg once weekly", "after 30 days on the 1.5 mg dose, increase the dose to 4 mg once daily", "patients treated with Rybelsus 14 mg daily can be transitioned to Ozempic subcutaneous injection 0.5 mg once weekly", "Mounjaro (tirzepatide, up to 15 mg once weekly)", "dose may be increased to 9 mg once daily", "once-weekly Mounjaro 5 mg", "once-weekly Mounjaro 15 mg", "once-weekly Mounjaro 10 mg", "4 NovoFine Plus needles with 1 mg and 2 mg pens", "6 NovoFine Plus needles with 0.25/0.5 mg dose pen", "increase occurs after at least 30 days on the 4 mg dose", "doses above 1,800 mg a day did not add benefit in studies", "daily doses higher than 240 mg administered in equally divided doses by 15-minute infusion have not been studied", "1 extra case per 6,700 people per year among white patients who had taken 50,000 mg or more", "twice usual daily dose every other morning", "up to 5 weeks"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
